푸시시.englishDescription: A word describing one’s falling asleep or daydreaming.

풍족히.englishDescription: In enough and ample quantity, without a shortage.

피둥피둥.definitionKo: 보기에 좋지 않을 정도로 살이 쪄서 퉁퉁한 모양.
피둥피둥.englishDescription: A word describing someone gaining weight and looking unattractively fat.

피둥피둥.definitionKo: 남의 말을 잘 듣지 않고 엇나가는 모양.
피둥피둥.englishDescription: A word describing someone not obeying others and behaving badly.

피라미.definitionKo: 몸은 길고 납작하며, 등은 푸른 갈색, 배는 은백색이고 옆구리에 어두운 파란색의 띠가 있는 민물고기.
피라미.englishDescription: A freshwater fish with a long and flat body, greenish brown back, and silver white belly, whose side has a dark blue stripe.

피의자.definitionKo: 범죄의 혐의는 인정되었으나 아직 검사에 의해 형사 재판이 청구되지 않은 사람.
피의자.englishDescription: A person who is charged with a crime, yet not indicted by a prosecutor for a criminal trial.

피해 의식.definitionKo: 다른 사람 때문에 자신의 권리나 명예 등이 손상되거나 신체나 재산 등이 손해를 입었다고 여기는 인식이나 감정.
피해 의식.englishDescription: A perception or feeling that one's rights or reputation have been damaged or that one's body or property has been damaged because of another person.

필수품.definitionKo: 일상생활에 없어서는 안 되는 반드시 필요한 물건.
필수품.englishDescription: The necessities for one's daily life.

하숙집.definitionKo: 일정한 돈을 내고 머물면서 먹고 자는 집.
하숙집.englishDescription: A house where a lodger stays, paying for a room and meals.
하숙집.englishExpression: boarding house; lodging house; rooming house

학교(는) 구경도 못하다.englishExpression: have never even sightseen a school

학벌.definitionKo: 학교 교육을 받아서 얻게 된 사회적 지위나 신분. 또는 출신 학교의 사회적 지위나 등급.
학벌.englishDescription: The social status or position one earns by receiving school education; or the social status or level of his/her school.

학벌.definitionKo: 출신 학교나 학파에 따라 갈라진 사람들의 집단.
학벌.englishDescription: A group of people distinguished by the school they graduated from, or the school of thought they belong to.

학술적.englishDescription: A state of involving academic knowledge and techniques.
학술적.englishExpression: being academic; being scientific; being scholarly

한국미.englishDescription: The beauty of Korea, or Korean aesthetic appeal.

한껏.englishDescription: The fullest extent possible or as long as one wants to do something.
한껏.englishExpression: to the fullest extent; to one's heart's content

한미.englishDescription: A compound noun for Korea and the United States.
한미.englishExpression: Korea and the United States; being Korean-American

할아범.englishDescription: An old man of low status.

할애.definitionKo: 귀중한 시간, 돈 공간 등을 아까워하지 않고 선뜻 내어 줌.
할애.englishDescription: An act of willingly giving one's precious time, money, space, etc., to another.

합집합.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 집합이 있을 때, 각 집합의 원소 전체로 이루어진 집합.
합집합.englishDescription: The set consisting of all elements from each set, when there are two or more sets.

항암제.definitionKo: 암세포가 커지거나 늘어나는 것을 억제하는 물질이나 약.
항암제.englishDescription: A substance or drug that curbs the growth in the size and number of cancer cells.

해금하다.englishDescription: To withdraw a ban on something.

해로.englishDescription: A way or route followed by a ship on the sea.

해로.definitionKo: 부부가 평생을 같이 살며 함께 늙음.
해로.englishDescription: A couple growing old together happily as husband and wife for the rest of their lives.

해롭다.definitionKo: 이롭지 않고 해가 되는 점이 있다.

annotations: 바다 위나 공중에서의 긴 거리를 나타내며 1해리는 1,852미터이다.
해리.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of distance.

해변가.definitionKo: 바다와 육지가 맞닿은 곳이나 그 근처.
해변가.englishDescription: A place where sea and land meet, or an area near such a place.

해상.englishDescription: A state of being on the sea.

해지다.englishDescription: To wear out so as to have a hole or be torn.
해지다.englishExpression: wear out; be tattered; become shabby

허둥지둥.definitionKo: 정신을 차릴 수 없을 만큼 이리저리 헤매며 다급하게 서두르는 모양.
허둥지둥.englishDescription: A word describing a state of being in a rush and wandering around to the extent of losing one's senses.
허둥지둥.englishExpression: hurriedly; in a rush; hastily; flusteredly

허물하다.englishDescription: To scold someone for making a mistake.

허사.definitionKo: 노력을 한 만큼의 좋은 결과를 얻지 못한 일.
허사.englishDescription: A state in which one's efforts fail to pay off.
허사.englishExpression: being in vain; coming to nothing

헛수고하다.englishDescription: To exert effort without any benefit or reward.

현실화하다.definitionKo: 현실로 되다. 또는 현실에 맞게 만들다.
현실화하다.englishDescription: To become real or to make something real.

혈통.englishDescription: The lineage of the same blood line.

협잡꾼.definitionKo: 자기에게 유리하게 하기 위해 옳지 않은 방법으로 남을 속이는 사람.
협잡꾼.englishDescription: A person who deceives others using inappropriate means to benefit himself/herself.

형수.definitionKo: 가족이나 친척 사이에서 형의 아내를 이르거나 부르는 말.
형수.englishDescription: A word used to refer to or address one's elder brother's wife in a family or among relatives.

형수.definitionKo: 남남의 남자 사이에서 형뻘이 되는 사람의 아내를 이르거나 부르는 말.
형수.englishDescription: A word used by a man to refer to or address the wife of someone who is like an older brother to him.

호들갑스럽다.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 가볍고 조심성이 없으며 야단스럽다.
호들갑스럽다.englishDescription: Acting or speaking in an imprudent, careless, and boisterous manner.

호랑이 없는 골에 토끼가 왕 노릇 한다.headword: 호랑이 없는 골에 토끼가 왕 노릇 한다

호의적.englishDescription: Showing a good feeling toward a certain object.
A state of showing a good feeling toward a certain object.

For the symptoms of a disease to come to grow better.

호주머니 사정이 좋다.englishDescription: For one's financial status to be good.

호흡을 맞추다.definitionKo: 일을 할 때 서로의 행동이나 의향을 잘 알고 처리하여 나가다.
호흡을 맞추다.englishDescription: To do something based on a full understanding of each other's intentions or thoughts.
호흡을 맞추다.englishExpression: keep steps with each other's breath

화급하다.englishDescription: Being urgent as if there were a fire nearby.

화초.definitionKo: 꽃이 피는 풀과 나무. 또는 두고 보면서 즐기는 모든 식물.
화초.englishDescription: Plants and trees that flower; or all the plants that one grows for admiration and enjoyment.

확답하다.englishDescription: To give an answer with certainty.

환기.englishDescription: An act of bringing a person's attention to a certain matter, or stirring up public opinion, thought, etc.

환기.definitionKo: 더럽고 탁한 공기를 맑은 공기로 바꿈.
환기.englishDescription: An act of changing dirty, stuffy air into fresh air.

활력소.englishDescription: An element that vitalizes one's life.
활력소.englishExpression: tonic; energizer; shot in the arm; refresher

활옷.definitionKo: 한국의 전통 결혼식 때 신부가 입는 옷.
활옷.englishDescription: Clothing worn by a bride at a traditional Korean wedding.

활자체.englishDescription: The style and size of printed characters.

활자화하다.definitionKo: 글이 인쇄되어 나오다. 또는 글을 인쇄하여 내다.
활자화하다.englishDescription: For a piece of writing to be produced in printed form; or to publish it in printed form.

황소 뒷걸음치다가 쥐 잡는다.englishDescription: An expression meaning one achieves something or makes a correct guess by chance.
황소 뒷걸음치다가 쥐 잡는다.englishExpression: A bull catches a mouse while backstepping

회원제.definitionKo: 회원을 대상으로 모임을 운영하거나 서비스를 제공하는 제도.
회원제.englishDescription: A system that runs meetings or provides services to members.

회의록.definitionKo: 여럿이 모여 의논한 내용, 진행 과정, 결과 등을 적은 기록.
회의록.englishDescription: A written record of the discussion, progress, and outcome of a meeting.

회초리.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물을 때릴 때에 쓰는 가는 나뭇가지.
회초리.englishDescription: A thin branch or stick used for whipping a person or animal.

회화하다.englishDescription: To meet another face-to-face and talk with him/her.
회화하다.englishExpression: talk with; chat with; have a dialogue

회화하다.englishDescription: To talk with another in a foreign language.

획정하다.definitionKo: 경계 등을 뚜렷하고 확실하게 구별하여 정하다.
획정하다.englishDescription: To draw clear boundaries, etc., to distinguish one from another.
획정하다.englishExpression: demarcate; draw a line; define a boundary

횡격막.definitionKo: 배와 가슴 사이에 가로로 걸쳐 둘을 분리하는 근육.
횡격막.englishDescription: The muscular partition that lies horizontally between the abdomen and the chest, separating the one from the other.

후후하다.definitionKo: 입을 동글게 오므려 내밀고 입김을 많이 자꾸 내뿜다.
후후하다.englishDescription: To let one's deep breath out repeatedly through pursed lips.

훈화.definitionKo: 교훈이나 가르침을 주는 말을 함. 또는 그런 말.
훈화.englishDescription: An act of giving another a talk that contains instructive contents or moral lessons; or such a talk.

훑어보다.definitionKo: 한쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝까지 쭉 보다.
훑어보다.englishDescription: To take a quick look at something from one end to another.
To examine something closely from the start to the end.

휴강하다.englishDescription: To cancel a class or lecture.
휴강하다.englishExpression: cancellation of lecture; cancellation of class

흘금대다.englishDescription: To look sideways at something furtively, repeatedly.
흘금대다.englishExpression: keep looking sideways; keep leering at

흘기다.englishDescription: To look aside by rolling one's eyes slightly to express one's disapproval.

흡연.englishDescription: An act of smoking a cigarette.

흡족.definitionKo: 조금도 모자람이 없을 정도로 넉넉하여 만족함.
흡족.englishDescription: A state of being pleased with something because it is sufficient without any shortage.

흥.definitionKo: 코를 세게 풀거나 콧김을 부는 소리.
흥.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of blowing one's nose hard or letting out breath through the nose.

흥.definitionKo: 비웃거나 아니꼬울 때 코로 내는 소리.
흥.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made through the nose when one laughs at someone or finds something annoying.

흥.definitionKo: 즐거운 감정. 또는 즐거움을 일어나게 하는 감정.
흥.englishDescription: A joyful feeling; or an emotion arousing joy.
